Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity desktop application screenshot, landscape 16:10, target 1920x1200, sharp readable Spanish typography, flat front view, no device frame, no perspective, no surrounding presentation board. Product: Yard Finder, an offline vehicle dispatch yard tool for a four-hour demo, simulated DJI Air 3S aerial surveys. Shared design system: graphite background #14171c, panels #1d2128, thin borders #2e343e, off-white #e8eaed, secondary gray #9aa3ae, warm yellow #ffc928 for primary actions and selections, green #3ddc84 for located vehicles, amber and muted red for exceptions. Refined practical industrial software, generous spacing, restrained rounded corners, crisp outline icons, no gradients or ornamental illustrations. Persistent left sidebar 210px wide: simple locator mark and "YARD FINDER", navigation "Patio", "Inventario", "Despacho", "Pasadas", "Excepciones", "Reportes"; footer "Modo local". Top bar: breadcrumb/current page, visible badge "DEMO · Datos simulados", small date "06 nov 2026". Map visual language: flat top-down site plan, 6 rectangular sectors numbered 1–6 in a 3-column by 2-row grid, parked car glyphs and clear drive aisles, dispatch gate at bottom; no satellite basemap, no invented map-provider branding. Data consistency for completed survey screens: 200 registered, 192 located, 8 unlocated; 4 located vehicles outside expected sector are a subset of the 192. Demo order is 12 white Fiat Cronos in sector 4, all located; don't invent measured operational savings. Use only relevant concise text, maintain large legible headings and controls. This is a design reference image, not a website screenshot from an existing product.
